metadata.title: TIMSS Data Base User Guide Supplement 2: International Versions of the Background Questionnaires – Population 2 Primary and Middle School Years

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a TIMSS international database user guide supplement that lists the international versions of background questionnaire items for Population 2 (student, mathematics teacher, science teacher, and school questionnaires). It does not provide an analytic sample, estimation results, or any description of how to apply sampling weights or replicate weights in secondary analyses. For users conducting analyses with TIMSS microdata, the appropriate approach is to apply the complex survey design weights supplied in the TIMSS international database (and replicate weights if provided) when estimating population-representative statistics and standard errors. Because this supplement focuses on questionnaire item comparability and variable naming, it does not specify any weight variable names (e.g., student design weights) or replicate-weight procedures.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This supplement is not an empirical study predicting or analyzing cognitive achievement outcomes; it is a documentation of questionnaire item content and international variable names. As a result, plausible values (PV-based achievement scores) are not part of the described workflow, and missing-data handling for PVs is not applicable. The document also does not report any model estimation or missing-data procedures because it does not conduct statistical analyses.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: No analytic sample is defined in this supplement. It provides the international versions of background questionnaire items (with NRC notes and international option placeholders) and an index of international background variable names for TIMSS Population 2.

data.outcome_summary: This TIMSS supplement is a questionnaire documentation resource rather than an empirical research paper. It provides international versions of the Population 2 background questionnaires for students (non-specialized and specialized versions), mathematics teachers, science teachers, and schools, and it lists the corresponding international background variable names (e.g., student items such as gender, language at home, time on extra lessons; teacher items such as age, education, teaching assignments; and school items such as instructional capacity and student composition). The supplement explains that NRCs may substitute wording or response options to fit national systems while retaining the same basic interpretation, and it points users to another supplement for documentation of national adaptations. Because it does not include an achievement outcome, scaling, PV generation, sampling, or statistical modeling, it cannot report performance metrics or effects. Its practical value is enabling secondary analysts to construct internationally comparable contextual variables for TIMSS-based analyses.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This record is extremely sparse with respect to empirical-method fields because the document is a TIMSS database user guide supplement that catalogs questionnaire items and variable names rather than conducting an analysis. Therefore, there is no dependent variable, no sampling frame, no PV/scaling procedure, and no ML or statistical modeling whose results could be extracted. The absence of sample sizes, countries, and model metrics is by design: the supplement is intended for variable harmonization and comparability, not for hypothesis testing.
